blocking: Three gold buttons live on every screen at once (Inquire pill, the fixed 'How we work +' tab, 'Begin the conversation'): the brand book allows one gold button, and on phone the tab pill also sits on top of the tree and the SCROLL cue
The termeh weave behind the How we work teaser renders as broken dark-red horizontal streaks, not a weave; at desktop it reads like a rendering glitch

fixes.what: Make the tab a ghost tab: background transparent, border 2px solid var(--gold), color var(--parch); keep ruby fill only on hover. On phone, move it above the SCROLL cue line (bottom: 72px) or hide it while .hero is in view
fixes.why: Restores the one-gold-button rule and stops a second gold pill competing with Inquire on every screen

fixes.what: Redraw the tile as a true diagonal boteh/paisley lattice (or a fine diamond lattice) at 320–400px, opacity .05, and add a 60% cypress radial fade over it so it only shows at the edges
fixes.why: The current tile shows as scan-line dashes; the pattern should whisper heritage, not look like a broken texture

fixes.what: Drop every 1px rgba-gold border; keep only border-top: 2px solid var(--gold) on cards and a 2px gold top rule on the form; for list rows use spacing (var(--s2)) instead of hairline tops
fixes.why: Brand book says no hairlines; the 1px gold outlines on cards and form currently box the layout like a grid

fixes.what: Set max-width: 30em, font-size clamp(22px,3vw,36px), and text-wrap: balance on each span (fallback: let spans flow inline with line-height 1.35)
fixes.why: At 40px the founder lines break as 'never two / people.' and 'the whole / table.', which reads sloppy on the one parchment moment

fixes.what: Replace the generated scribble path with a scanned signature traced as a single path, or remove the SVG and set 'Medi, founder' in gold eyebrow style
fixes.why: A random squiggle presented as a signature reads as costume and undercuts the letter's sincerity

fixes.what: Change to `.site-header--solid .nav-home, .site-header.is-scrolled .nav-home{display:block}` and fade it in with opacity .4s
fixes.why: Once the hero logo blurs away, the home page scrolls with no Anar mark in the header; the brand should stay present on every scroll point
